meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 Chat SDK 桥接接入 Linear:已配置团队里的 issue 一有新评论,它就会自动回复,无需 @ 提及;每条 issue 的评论线程是一个独立对话。
howto.when: 当已配置的 Linear 团队中某个 issue 收到新评论时触发;该团队所有 issue 的评论都会自动进入 agent,不需要 @ 提及。

say.text: 请看一下这个 issue,给出你的分析。
say.note: 这条评论会触发 agent 在该线程自动回复。

say.text: 这个 bug 可能是什么原因?
say.note: 评论发出后 agent 会接入并回答。

say.text: 这个需求目前进展如何?
say.note: 同样会触发 agent 参与该 issue 的评论。

howto.what_en: After this skill is installed, Claude joins Linear through the Chat SDK bridge: every new comment on an issue in the configured team gets an automatic reply, with no @-mention required; each issue thread becomes its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a new comment is posted on an issue in the configured Linear team. All comments on that team's issues are routed to the agent, without needing an @-mention.

say_en.text: Please look at this issue and give your analysis.
say_en.note: This comment triggers the agent to reply in that thread.

say_en.text: What might be causing this bug?
say_en.note: Once posted, the agent will join and answer.

say_en.text: What's the current status of this request?
say_en.note: Also triggers the agent to join this issue's comments.
